title.narrative: Strengthened institutional capacity of employers' organizations

description.narrative: With the ILO’s instituted process towards introducing a new international labour standard to support decent work in the platform economy, the employers’ organization seeks to not only enhance members’ understanding of the platform economy, but to also prepare them to effectively engage in the policy discourse on the platform economy and contribute to the design of the new ILO standard for the platform economy. Building on previous work to establish a free-to-use webtool to assist small and informal businesses to operate within the employment legislation framework, the representative employers’ organization seeks to strengthen its provision of services through the webtool by integrating audio-visuals to facilitate learning by SMEs on South African labour law and acceptable workplace management practices. As critical actors in the policy space, the employers’ organization is not as effectively engaged in influencing economic, social, and environmental policies through the UN Cooperation Framework processes. The strategy will focus on capacity and policy advisory support to the representative employers’ organization to develop a business position on the platform economy and to enhance their effective engagement in policy discourse on the platform economy, and to participate effectively in the ILC’s standard setting committee for the platform economy, and other standard-setting processes. In addition, capacity support will be provided to facilitate the representative employers’ organization’s continued extension of services to SMEs. And to facilitate the engagement of the employers’ organization to influence the economic, social, and environmental policies through the processes of the United Nations Sustainable Development Cooperation Framework.
